observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 171.» (L7) and «p. 172.» (L21) in the right margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 45: 15 stands in the space between «CAPUT XLV.» and the title, 20 beside L16. The 0 of the line number 40 is printed broken. The signature 15 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
body L12-L14: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.

body L3, L6, L8, L18, L21: specks stand over the Q of «circa Q», under the i of «in» before «directione», over the second t of the second «directio», over the e of «eo» and before «motus medius»; they are not signs.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
